study: UK House of Commons 2024 election official constituency-level results
unit: UK constituency; up to 650, 4 nations and English regions
prespecified_exclusions: Only missing electorate/turnout or no winner-runner candidate votes for computation; report exclusions and special Speaker/NI observations; don't discard by result
classification: All cycles exploratory until independently replicated; contemporaneous margins and vote shares are post-election, cannot be used in genuine pre-election prediction.
A: Can the official Commons Library original CSV be retrieved as genuine bytes, hashed, parsed, and reconciled across 650 constituencies with published headline turnout and seat counts?

B.H1: 650 unique constituencies and numeric turnout/majority fields; independent candidate CSV permits vote-sum spot checks
B.H0: Missing/duplicate or nonnumeric source; block and pivot, never guess rows

C: Download exact official URL(s), SHA256 original bytes; examine schema, grain, duplicates, missingness and aggregate consistency; record revisions and source timestamp conservatively; never replace bad values silently.
F: Library compilation is from local authority official declarations but version revised; original publication time unknown
G: One institutional source, candidate data same publisher; not an independent issuer replicate.
H: CT2 stays 29 unless PFL identity hypothesis actually tested
I: Do not store individual candidate names in user-facing report
J: If accessible analyze the fixed 650 source; if not, blocked capture to Codex and pivot.
